ja501:4.1: gacchāmi, hadayam me avakaḍḍhati, na taṃ baddhaṃ jahissāmi, idha hessāmi jīvitan ti.
ja501:5.1: Gaccha bhīru palāyassu, kūṭe baddho 'smi āyase, gaccha tuvam pi, mā kaṃkhi, jīvissanti tayā sahā 'ti.
ja501:6.1: Nāhaṃ Rohanta gacchāmi, hadayam me avakaḍḍhati, na taṃ ahaṃ jahissāmi, idha hessāmi jīvitaṃ.
ja501:7.1: Te hi nūna marissanti andhā aparināyikā, gaccha tuvam pi, mā kaṃkhi, jīvissanti tayā saha.
ja501:8.1: Nāhaṃ Rohanta gacchāmi, hadayam me avakaḍḍhati, na taṃ baddhaṃ jahissāmi, idha hessāmi jīvitan ti.
ja501:9.1: Ayaṃ so luddako eti ruddarūpo sahāvudho, so no vadhissati ajja usunā sattiyā-m-apīti.
ja501:10.1: Sā muhuttaṃ palāyitvā bhayaṭṭhā bhayatajjitā sudukkaraṃ akarā bhīru maraṇāy' ūpanivattathā ti.
ja501:11.1: Kin nu te 'me migā honti, muttā baddhaṃ upāsare, na taṃ cajitum icchanti jīvitassa pi kāraṇā ti
ja501:12.1: Bhātaro honti me ludda saudariyā ekamātukā, na mañ cajitum icchanti jīvitassa pi kāraṇā
ja501:13.1: ti. Te hi nūna marissanti andhā aparināyikā, pañcannaṃ jīvitaṃ dehi, bhātaraṃ muñca luddakā 'ti
ja501:14.1: So vo ahaṃ pamokkhāmi mātāpettibharaṃ migaṃ, nandantu mātāpitaro muttaṃ disvā mahāmigan ti.
ja501:15.1: Evaṃ luddaka nandassu saha sabbehi ñātibhi yathāham ajja nandāmi muttaṃ disvā mahāmigan ti
ja501:16.1: Kathaṃ pamokkho āsi upanītasmiṃ jīvite, kathaṃ putta amocesi kūṭapāsamha luddako ti
ja501:17.1: Bhaṇaṃ kaṇṇasukhaṃ vācaṃ hadayaṅgaṃ hadayanissitaṃ subhāsitāhi vācāhi Cittako maṃ amocayi.
ja501:18.1: Bhaṇaṃ kaṇṇasukhaṃ vācaṃ hadayaṅgaṃ hadayanissitaṃ subhāsitāhi vācāhi Sutanā maṃ amocayi.
ja501:19.1: Sutvā kaṇṇasukhaṃ vācaṃ hadayaṅgaṃ hadayanissitaṃ subhāsitāni sutvāna luddako maṃ amocayīti.
ja501:20.1: Evaṃ ānandito hotu saha dārehi luddako yathā may' ajja nandāma disvā Rohantam āgatan ti.
ja501:21.1: Nanu tvaṃ avacā ludda: migacammāni āhariṃ, atha kena nu vaṇṇena migacammāni nāharīti.
ja501:22.1: Āgamā c' eva hatthatthaṃ kūṭapāsañ ca so migo, abajjhi, tañ ca migarājaṃ tañ ca muttā upāsare.
ja501:23.1: Tassa me āhu saṃvego abbhuto lomahaṃsano, imañ c' āhaṃ migaṃ haññe ajja hassāmi jīvitan ti āha.
ja501:24.1: Kīdisā te migā ludda, kīdisā dhammikā migā, kathaṃvannā kathaṃsīlā, bāḷham kho te pasaṃsasīti.
ja501:25.1: Odātasiṅgā sucivālā jātarūpatacūpamā, pādālohitakātesaṃ, añjitakkhā manoramā ti gātham āha.
ja501:26.1: Edisā te migā deva, edisā dhammikā migā, mātāpettibharā devā, na te so abhihārayan ti Dammi
ja501:27.1: nikkhasataṃ ludda thullañ ca maṇikuṇḍalaṃ catussadañ ca pallaṃkaṃ ummāpupphasirinnibhaṃ
ja501:28.1: Dve ca sādisiyo bhariyā usabhañ ca gavaṃ sataṃ, dhammena rajjaṃ kāressaṃ, bahukāro me si luddaka.
ja501:29.1: Kasī vaṇijjā iṇadānaṃ uñchācariyāya luddakaetehi dāraṃ posehi. mā pāpaṃ akarā punan ti
